verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no saved snippets, canned responses, or templates feature with variables or attachments. Gemini drafting, one-click suggested replies, and add-ons that can auto-create drafts are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a user-managed template capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
